text:
Matvei Michkov is the most talked-about player in Philadelphia right now, and not only for the scoring. He leads the Flyers with 10 goals in 18 games, eight of them in his last ten, and the conversation around him is about his minutes under Rick Tocchet. Philly Sports Reports put it plainly in a headline: "Matvei Michkov is Scoring Like a Star While Rick Tocchet Still Limits His Minutes." Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports wrote this week that if there is tension in the room around Michkov, the group has to figure it out.

Our numbers split the difference. The hot streak is earned: his own chances are up, and he is on the ice for 78 percent of the power play, up from 43. But 10 goals on 5.3 expected is 37 percent shooting, and nobody keeps that up. The counterweight is that Philadelphia has scored 5.5 fewer goals than its chances with him on the ice, so some points are owed back.

He is 21, playing 15:54 a night. The scoring will cool. The case for more ice time won't.
headline: Michkov leads the Flyers in goals and in debate
